stories.title: Dwarka Expressway luxury home sales reach 8,347 crore
stories.summary: Sales of homes priced above 10 crore surged 22 fold on the Dwarka Expressway this Diwali. Average residential prices in the area rose 135 percent between 2021 and mid 2026. Premium housing continues to drive the market as infrastructure projects reach completion.

stories.title: Prestige Group acquires Allure Developers for 524 crore
stories.summary: Prestige Estates Projects has acquired a 100 percent stake in Allure Developers for 524 crore. The deal serves as part of the company's expansion into the Delhi NCR market. Allure is currently developing a residential project in Noida.

stories.title: Prestige Group expands in Noida with 524 crore acquisition
stories.summary: Prestige Estates Projects has acquired a 100 percent stake in Allure Developers for 524 crore. The company will pay the consideration in tranches to support a residential project in Noida Sector 150. Allure is now a wholly owned subsidiary of the firm.

stories.title: Ahmedabad real estate demand rises 13.5 percent
stories.summary: Ahmedabad is on a distinct growth trajectory with real estate demand rising 13.5 percent, according to CREDAI. Chairman Rajesh Vaswani attributed the surge to infrastructure projects like the bullet train and GIFT City. Festive season buying has further supported the market trend.

stories.title: Ahmedabad real estate demand rises 13.5 percent
stories.summary: Ahmedabad real estate demand rose 13.5 percent, according to CREDAI. Chairman Rajesh Vaswani attributed the growth to infrastructure developments including the bullet train and GIFT City. The market is expected to sustain this trajectory as the festive season continues.

stories.title: Mumbai homebuyer bookings slow despite festive interest
stories.summary: Mumbai developers are reporting higher walk-ins and enquiries this Diwali, but converting interest into bookings is taking longer. Experts cite rising property prices and geopolitical uncertainty as reasons for the delay. Homebuyers are spending more time evaluating projects before committing to a purchase.

stories.title: Hyderabad leads Q3 residential sales growth
stories.summary: India's seven major residential markets saw sales rise 6 percent to 214,562 units in the first nine months of 2026. JLL reports that premium apartments priced at 1 crore and above captured 72 percent of total sales. The sector is recovering from a 2025 decline.

stories.title: Mumbai, Bengaluru and Pune lead residential launches
stories.summary: Mumbai, Bengaluru and Pune accounted for 60 percent of new residential launches in the first quarter of 2026. Cushman and Wakefield reported 75,283 new units across eight cities, a 1 percent increase from the previous year. Mumbai led the national activity with 19,775 new units.

stories.title: Arkade Developers buys Bhandup land for 145.51 crore
stories.summary: Arkade Developers has acquired a land parcel in Bhandup West for 145.51 crore. The company plans to develop a premium residential project on the site with an estimated gross development value of 1,800 crore. This is the firm's second acquisition in the area.

stories.title: Max Estates secures 5.5 acres in Noida
stories.summary: Max Estates has secured a 5.5 acre mixed use land parcel in Noida Sector 132 for 272 crore. The plot was acquired through an e-auction conducted by the local authority. The project will be developed under terms allowing a floor area ratio of 2.0.

stories.title: Linden residential real estate sales summary
stories.summary: Five residential sales were recorded in Linden between October 26 and November 1. The average sale price was 438,300 dollars, with an average price of 409 dollars per square foot. The most expensive property sold for 818,000 dollars.

stories.title: Marseilles single family home sells for 435,000 dollars
stories.summary: A 1,842 square foot home in Marseilles sold for 435,000 dollars on October 16. The single story property includes a fireplace and sits on a 0.8 acre lot. The sale price equates to 236 dollars per square foot.

stories.title: Lee County and Whiteside residential property deals
stories.summary: A home in Dixon sold for 119,000 dollars, leading the list of residential deals in Lee County and Whiteside for the week of October 26. The average price for properties in the area was 167,652 dollars. A total of 41 sales were recorded.

stories.title: Plainfield area residential sales summary
stories.summary: Twenty three residential sales were recorded in the Plainfield area between October 19 and November 1. The average sale price was 521,718 dollars, or 346 dollars per square foot. The highest priced sale reached 999,999 dollars.

stories.title: Hamilton area residential sales summary
stories.summary: Thirty four residential sales were registered in the Hamilton area between October 26 and November 1. The average price was 404,109 dollars, with an average of 289 dollars per square foot. The top sale was a home in Trenton for 740,000 dollars.

stories.title: Kendall County residential property deals
stories.summary: A home in Oswego sold for 285,000 dollars, leading the list of residential deals in Kendall County for the week of October 26. The average price for properties in the area was 375,073 dollars. A total of 43 sales were recorded.

stories.title: McHenry County residential property deals
stories.summary: A home in McHenry sold for 244,000 dollars, leading the list of residential deals in McHenry County for the week of October 26. The average price for properties in the area was 415,085 dollars. A total of 48 sales were recorded.

stories.title: La Salle County residential property deals
stories.summary: A home in Ottawa sold for 113,000 dollars, leading the list of residential deals in La Salle County for the week of October 26. The average price for properties in the area was 184,457 dollars. A total of 23 sales were recorded.

stories.title: Gig Harbor homes listed for sale
stories.summary: Paige Schulte of Neighborhood Experts Real Estate has listed four Gig Harbor properties with a combined value of approximately $6.2 million. The lead listing, a 1990-built house in the Canterwood Golf and Country Club, is priced at $1,025,000. Schulte reports 114 sales over the past year.

stories.title: Chhattisgarh housing board doubles revenue
stories.summary: The Chhattisgarh Housing and Infrastructure Development Board sold 7,650 homes between 2024 and mid-2026, matching its sales volume from the previous five years. Annual revenue doubled to over Rs 600 crore following administrative reforms and a settlement scheme for unpaid dues. The board is now selling faster.

stories.title: Baldwin County housing prices climb
stories.summary: Average residential sales prices in Baldwin County rose to $793,039 in the resort sector during October, an 11.4 percent increase from the previous year. While resort properties sold faster, traditional home sales remained steady. The market continues to see higher prices alongside a decrease in available listings.

stories.title: DDA launches new housing scheme
stories.summary: The Delhi Development Authority has opened registrations for its Khushhaal Pariwaar Yojana 2026, offering 445 Middle Income Group flats. Units are located in Narela, Loknayakpuram and Jahangirpuri, with prices starting at Rs 43 lakh. Booking for the units is scheduled to begin on November 16.

stories.title: Kimco Realty buys Louisville retail centers
stories.summary: Kimco Realty agreed to acquire two grocery-anchored shopping centers in Louisville for $295 million. Management plans to use capital recycling to target remerchandising and below-market rents. The company describes the properties as prominent assets located in a supply-constrained retail market with high occupancy levels.

stories.title: HSBC sub-leases Bengaluru office space
stories.summary: HSBC has sub-leased 119,751 square feet of office space at the Ecospace Campus in Bengaluru for a total rent exceeding Rs 207 crore. The agreement includes 119 parking spaces and a monthly rent of Rs 3.19 crore. The office is located on the established Outer Ring Road.

stories.title: Delhi-NCR office rents rank high
stories.summary: Delhi-NCR is the seventh-most expensive prime office market in the Asia-Pacific region, with annual costs reaching $73.11 per square foot. Vacancy rates stood at 14.5 percent at the end of the third quarter. The region maintains its position despite unchanged rents on a quarterly basis.

stories.summary: Franklin Street Properties is offering an 11-building office portfolio in North Texas totaling 4.6 million square feet. Occupancy rates for the properties range from 41 percent to 65 percent. The sale will test buyer appetite for discounted, partly vacant suburban offices in a market favoring newer trophy assets.

stories.title: Prologis to redevelop casino site
stories.summary: Prologis has formed a joint venture with Gaming and Leisure Properties to convert the former Hollywood Casino Joliet site into a warehouse and distribution park. The project marks the casino firm's first entry into industrial real estate. The site is intended to serve modern logistics users.

stories.title: Rajasthan plans industrial area expansion
stories.summary: Rajasthan is planning to develop more than 300 hectares in the Jodhpur-Pali-Marwar Industrial Area. The expansion follows interest from foreign investors and businesses in white and green industry categories. Officials are currently reviewing infrastructure development plans for the northern section of the project.

stories.title: Florida firm plans Shelbyville distribution centers
stories.summary: Blue Steel Development has acquired 309 acres in Shelbyville to construct two Class A distribution centers totaling nearly 2 million square feet. The $175 million project, known as Steel 64, is scheduled to begin construction before the end of the year to fulfill various industrial needs.

stories.title: Lake County industrial space demand grows
stories.summary: Lake County is seeing a rise in industrial projects as the area faces a 2.1 percent vacancy rate for flex industrial space. Developers are planning new construction to accommodate the need for facilities that combine office, warehouse and retail uses. Growth is currently outpacing available supply.

stories.title: AdaniConneX acquires Vizag data center park
stories.summary: AdaniConneX has signed an agreement to acquire 100 percent of Vizag Mega Data Center Park for Rs 1,085.51 crore. The transaction, expected to close by November 10, provides the joint venture with land and licenses for infrastructure development. The data center sector continues to see significant capital investment.

stories.title: Google plans Wyoming data centre with 702 MW fuel cells
stories.summary: Google is investing US$17 billion in a Wyoming data centre, its first in the state. The project includes a 702 MW fuel cell deployment and carbon capture technology to support AI infrastructure. The company says the investment will strengthen cloud services and generate local economic activity.

stories.title: Rironi to Naivasha highway expansion targets December opening
stories.summary: Engineers are attempting to lay 1 km of asphalt daily on the Rironi to Naivasha highway to meet a December deadline. The government says the project will ease congestion and improve connectivity between Nairobi and western Kenya. The festive season is the primary driver for the current pace of work.

stories.title: Kanpur Metro bridge design avoids central pillars
stories.summary: Kanpur Metro is building a 67.5-metre steel arch bridge to carry Corridor 2 over a highway. The Open Web Truss Girder design allows the structure to span the road without a central pillar. The design aims to keep the junction clear while supporting the elevated line.

stories.title: Delhi proposes elevated corridor for Shivaji Marg
stories.summary: The Delhi Public Works Department has proposed a 2.2-km elevated corridor on Shivaji Marg to bypass surface-level traffic. The four-lane structure is intended to provide a signal-free connection between the Zakhira and Karampura flyovers. The project aims to move traffic through a difficult urban interface.

stories.title: Pedestrian safety concerns rise along Dharwad BRTS corridor
stories.summary: A student was hit by a bus at a Vidyagiri junction, renewing calls for improved pedestrian safety on the Dharwad BRTS corridor. Residents are demanding skywalks and subways, citing faulty design at busy intersections. The debate over how to cross the dedicated bus lanes continues.

stories.title: Bhopal proposes 51-km growth corridor
stories.summary: Bhopal’s draft development plan proposes a 51-km growth corridor requiring 3,000 hectares of land. The project is estimated to cost ₹20,000 crore and aims to develop peripheral areas through mixed-use hubs. Funding for the development has not yet been finalised.

stories.title: Pune bridge reopens for Diwali shoppers
stories.summary: The Baba Bhide bridge in Pune has reopened to traffic to assist Diwali shoppers and commuters. Maha Metro says work on a foot overbridge has reached its final phase, allowing for the removal of full-day closures. Remaining construction is expected to finish by December.

stories.title: Bengaluru to replace flyovers with elevated corridor
stories.summary: The Bangalore Development Authority plans to spend ₹725 crore on an elevated corridor along Ballari Road. The project requires the demolition of existing flyovers at Ganganagar and Sanjaynagar. Officials have set an 18-month deadline, aligning the completion date with the 2028 Assembly elections.

stories.title: Karnataka approves ₹20,000 crore in road projects
stories.summary: The Karnataka Cabinet has approved ₹20,000 crore for state highways, major district roads and bridge construction. The funding falls under the Public Works Department. The cabinet also scheduled a legislative session for early December in Belagavi, following a brief change in dates.

stories.title: Court rules new developers not liable for predecessors
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court ruled that a developer taking over a stalled project is not automatically responsible for the previous builder's financial debts. The court set aside a MahaRERA order that had directed a new developer to pay interest on a debt owed by a former firm.

stories.title: Sialkot orders construction sites to cover materials
stories.summary: The Sialkot Anti-Smog Committee has ordered officials to enforce rules requiring construction materials to be covered. The directive follows concerns over air quality and smog levels in the district. Authorities have warned that legal action will be taken against those who fail to comply.

stories.title: Noida residents flag fire risk in parks
stories.summary: The Sector 122 Residents Welfare Association has asked the Noida authority to clear dry waste from parks, citing fire risks during Diwali. Residents allege that irregular cleaning has led to an accumulation of leaves and garbage. The RWA has also requested better lighting and tree pruning.

stories.title: Rajasthan proposes incentives for affordable housing
stories.summary: The Rajasthan Urban Development Department has proposed fee waivers and revised distance norms to encourage private developers to build affordable housing. The draft amendments to the Mukhyamantri Jan Awas Yojana aim to ensure projects remain viable and resolve issues regarding location, infrastructure, and construction delays.

stories.title: West Bengal updates land acquisition policy
stories.summary: West Bengal has introduced an investment policy to encourage industries to acquire land directly from owners. Companies purchasing 500 acres independently can now qualify for strategic and mega project status. Projects using government-allotted land remain subject to a 1,000-acre minimum requirement.

stories.title: ED investigates former Punjab minister for land deals
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has accused former Punjab industries minister Sunder Sham Arora of extending favours to property developers in land transactions and acquiring stakes in real estate firms. The agency searched 14 premises linked to the former minister and his associates. Arora has denied any wrongdoing.

stories.title: Rental reversions rise across Singapore REITs
stories.summary: Most Singapore real estate investment trusts reported positive rental reversions for the period ending September 30. Despite this, distributions remained mixed due to portfolio occupancy, currency fluctuations, and financing costs. The top five most-traded REITs all reported positive rental growth.

stories.title: Simon Property Group raises 2026 outlook
stories.summary: Simon Property Group raised its 2026 funds from operations guidance to $13.30 to $13.40 per share. The company is targeting a fourth-quarter close for its University Village acquisition, which it expects to be modestly accretive next year. It has not disclosed the purchase price.

stories.title: Hudson Pacific Properties reports Q3 loss
stories.summary: Hudson Pacific Properties raised its 2026 core funds from operations outlook to $1.15 to $1.21 per share. Revenue declined to $180.9 million, and the net loss widened to $218.1 million, driven by non-cash impairments and a property-sale loss. Office occupancy climbed to 85.6 percent.

stories.title: Starwood Property Trust reviews dividend policy
stories.summary: Starwood Property Trust reported third-quarter distributable earnings of $0.31 per share, below its $0.48 payout. The board is reviewing the dividend following a $369 million increase in reserves against commercial loan non-accruals. No decision on a potential cut has been announced.

stories.title: American Healthcare REIT reports margin growth
stories.summary: American Healthcare REIT increased its full-year normalized funds from operations guidance following its third-quarter earnings call. The company reported that revenue per occupied room in its senior housing portfolio grew faster than operating expenses, leading to an expansion of operating spreads.

stories.title: Orion Office REIT raises guidance
stories.summary: Orion Office REIT raised its 2026 core funds from operations guidance to $0.75 to $0.78 per share, citing strong leasing activity. Portfolio occupancy rose to 78.3 percent. The company’s strategic options review remains ongoing, though higher interest rates have slowed the process.

stories.title: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank enters Indian market
stories.summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank has committed capital to the HDFC Capital Development of Real Estate Affordable and Mid-Income Fund. This marks the Japanese institution's first investment in an Indian real estate fund, executed through an offshore feeder structure.

stories.title: DLF to invest in IREO joint venture
stories.summary: DLF Ltd plans to invest Rs 3,750 crore to acquire a majority stake in a joint venture with Everstone. The partnership intends to invest in IREO Group companies to enhance governance and operational capabilities. The transaction is expected to be completed by next year.

stories.title: Starwood Property Trust reports $390 million loss
stories.summary: Starwood Property Trust reported a net loss of $389.7 million for the third quarter of 2026, a sharp decline from the $72.6 million profit reported in the same period last year. The loss was fueled by a $336.6 million credit loss provision.

stories.title: Changer Club partners with Dubai PropTech group
stories.summary: Changer Club has been named the official investment partner of the Dubai PropTech Business Group. The partnership aims to connect the emirate's real estate technology ecosystem with an international network of wealthy families. Members of the club represent a reported $25 billion in combined capital.

stories.title: Trust Moments launches AI real estate platform
stories.summary: Trust Moments has launched an AI-assisted platform designed to help agents understand buyer preferences and manage client relationships. The company has begun pilot implementations with agents in Arizona and California, marketing the tool as a way to free up time for real estate professionals.

stories.title: Compass responds to Open Real Estate initiative
stories.summary: Compass CEO Robert Reffkin said the company welcomes the Open Real Estate initiative, noting that it validates the firm's messaging regarding listing control. Reffkin stated there is a path for Compass to join the service, which aims to return listing power to creators.

stories.title: Proptech market growth continues
stories.summary: Future Market Insights expects the global proptech market to reach $47.8 billion by 2032, up from $19.6 billion in 2023. Women are increasingly leading firms in the sector, which covers areas including AI investment tools, co-buying agreements, and sustainability data.

stories.title: Vietnam to mandate energy labels for construction materials
stories.summary: The Ministry of Construction has issued Circular 81/2026/TT-BXD, requiring energy efficiency labels on building materials. The implementation roadmap runs from 2029 to 2031, with non-fired building materials included from January 1, 2031. The labels provide thermal property data to help users choose products. Regulations take effect in 2027.

stories.title: Doman Q3 net earnings rise to $19.7 million
stories.summary: Vancouver-based Doman Building Materials reported Q3 net earnings of $19.7 million, up from $18.1 million year-over-year. Revenue grew 5.9 percent to $841.7 million, driven by higher pricing. Gross margin narrowed to 14.8 percent from 15.5 percent, citing lower SYP prices and increased freight and fuel costs.

stories.summary: National Fire Authority chief Puamau Sowane says combustible building materials are contributing to high home destruction rates in Fiji. Residential properties accounted for 96 percent of 140 structures lost to fire between 2023 and 2026. Sowane notes that many homes lack fire-rated materials to delay the spread of flames.

stories.title: Colliers expects green-certified offices to dominate by 2030
stories.summary: Green-certified buildings are projected to account for nearly 75 percent of India's Grade A office stock by 2030, according to Colliers India. Leasing in green assets is expected to reach 65 million square feet in 2026, representing 85 percent of total leasing activity in major markets.

stories.summary: Sarawak has unveiled a Net Zero 2050 Strategy targeting RM347 billion in green investments and a 35 percent reduction in carbon emissions. stories.title: Beijing property stimulus fails to lift lower-tier cities
stories.summary: Beijing’s latest property stimulus package has failed to stop a downward spiral in home transactions and prices in mainland China’s lower-tier cities. According to data from the China Real Estate Index System, new home prices in these regions dropped 2 percent year on year in October. Incentives remain insufficient.

stories.title: Foreign buyers reach record share of Spanish property market
stories.summary: Foreign buyers accounted for 16.05 percent of all Spanish home sales in the third quarter, the highest share since records began. While foreign interest grows, total sales and mortgages have fallen for three straight quarters. The market is setting records for both prices and the absence of local buyers.

stories.title: US home prices fall for third consecutive week
stories.summary: US home-sale prices fell year over year for the third consecutive week, marking the first sustained pullback after three years of gains. The median home-sale price reached $388,604 for the four weeks ending November 1. Gradual affordability gains are expected to define 2026, according to market forecasters.

stories.title: New Mexico inventory rises as mortgage rates hold steady
stories.summary: Inventory in Albuquerque has climbed 20 percent, providing buyers with more options as mortgage rates hover at 7.18 percent. Realtor Skip Adams noted that homes typically spend 45 days on the market. Buyers now have breathing room, provided they can manage the cost of borrowing.

stories.title: Pending US home sales hit lowest October level since 2018
stories.summary: Newly pending listings fell 16.8 percent year over year in October, the steepest annual drop since August 2023. Completed home sales also fell 8.7 percent as mortgage rates remained above 7 percent. The housing market is currently recording its slowest October for contract signings in six years.

stories.title: Brisbane property market cools
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Brisbane property market cools sharply as buyers regain the upper hand. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Australian house prices record fastest decline in 40 years
stories.summary: Australian house prices have plunged 6.7 percent since the March peak, the fastest rate of decline in more than 40 years. The Reserve Bank of Australia recently hiked its cash rate to an 18-year high. Affordability and serviceability constraints are currently weighing on the market.

stories.title: US home prices decline for first time in three years
stories.summary: For the first time in more than three years, American home prices are falling. Redfin reported that the median U.S. home-sale price dipped 0.1 percent year over year in late October. Sellers are cutting prices, yet buyers remain away as a bond market shock continues to squeeze the sector.
